svg.text: STAGE 385 · TOPIC 25 FAQ
Bluetooth HFP/SCO Route-Switch Guard & WebRTC Opus DTX Deadlock Breaker
>=-3dBFS Pop Mute + 600–900ms VAD Freeze + CVSD/mSBC Recalibration (P763) & 120–200ms Zero-PCM Tail + 80–120ms Pre-Roll (P764)
1. Bluetooth HFP/SCO Handover Pop & Codec Recalibration (P763)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Raw Route Switch (Handset ↔ AirPods / Car HFP)
• -1 dBFS DC transient pop during SCO link setup triggers false Barge-In
• 500ms Bluetooth profile switch gap triggers premature EOU mid-sentence
• Uncalibrated 48kHz ASR hallucinates on CVSD 8kHz / mSBC 16kHz fallback
✅ Production Pattern: 600–900ms VAD Freeze + Frontend Recalibration (P763)
1. Transient Pop Clamp: Attenuate >=-3 dBFS route-switch spikes in 0ms
2. Handover VAD/EOU Freeze: Hold turn state for 600ms–900ms during HFP switch
3. Dynamic Sample-Rate Recalibration: Switch ASR frontend to 8kHz/16kHz
4. Seamless Cabin/Earbud Transition: 0 false barge-ins & 0 dropped turns
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateBluetoothHfpScoHandoverGlitch...):
popMuted=true && vadFreezeWindowMs in [600,900] && sampleRateHz>=8000
2. WebRTC Opus DTX Deadlock Breaker & Onset Pre-Roll Gate (P764)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Raw Opus DTX (usedtx=1) into Frame-Driven Server VAD
• Caller stops talking -> Opus DTX halts RTP packets (1 CN pkt per 400ms)
• Server VAD hangover timer starves for frames -> Mutual-Silence Deadlock!
• DTX wake-up without ring buffer clips initial plosive/fricative ("Seven"->"even")
✅ Production Pattern: 120–200ms Zero-PCM Tail + 80–120ms Pre-Roll (P764)
1. DTX Gap Detector: On >40ms RTP inter-arrival, synthesize 20ms zero-PCM frames
2. 120–200ms Synthetic Tail: Flushes Server VAD hangover counter deterministically
3. 80–120ms Circular Pre-Roll Buffer: Prepends onset frames before DTX wake-up
4. Zero Deadlocks & Zero Clipped Digits: Saves 68% silent uplink bandwidth safely
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateWebrtcOpusDtxSparseFrameVad...):
zeroPcmTailMs in [120ms,200ms] && onsetPrerollMs in [80ms,120ms]
Stage 385 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (388 Dimensions · 773 Guardrails · 782 Probes · 827 Unit Tests)
• Bluetooth Handover Gate (P763): 0% false barge-in during car/TWS switch; Opus DTX Gate (P764): 0% mutual-silence deadlocks & 0% onset clipping.
